environment.description: AWS Lambda function running behind API Gateway with gRPC-Web transcoding. The Lambda has an execution role with states:StartExecution and states:DescribeExecution permissions on all state machines (Resource: '*'). No metadata filtering is applied at the API Gateway level. The gRPC server runs in a container on ECS Fargate with no network policies restricting outbound calls to Step Functions. Client-supplied metadata headers are passed through without modification by the ALB.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API with gRPC passthrough, no request validation
config.network: VPC with full outbound internet access
